name: universal-platform
description: Universal multi-platform foundation: Website + Telegram Bot + Telegram Mini App on one backend and one database

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w bot && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w bot && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,bot,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w bot" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push
